article.headline: Memphis takes on New Orleans, aims for 7th straight win
article.description: New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 11th in the Western Conference) vs. Memphis Grizzlies (6-0, first in the Western Conference)
article.title: Memphis takes on New Orleans, aims for 7th straight win
article.linkText: Memphis takes on New Orleans, aims for 7th straight win
article.story: New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 11th in the Western Conference) vs. Memphis Grizzlies (6-0, first in the Western Conference) Memphis, Tennessee; Monday, 8 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Memphis will try to keep its six-game win streak intact when the Grizzlies take on New Orleans. Memphis finished 25-57 overall, 19-33 in Western Conference games and 14-27 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Grizzlies averaged 18.0 points off of turnovers, 14.9 second-chance points and 46.0 bench points last season. New Orleans finished 26-56 overall, 7-9 in Southwest Division play and 9-32 on the road last season. The Pelicans averaged 115.5 points per game last season, 57.7 in the paint, 17.9 off of turnovers and 17.0 on fast breaks. INJURIES: Grizzlies: Scotty Pippen Jr.: out (back), Ty Jerome: out (back), Quinten Post: out (ankle). Pelicans: Dejounte Murray: out (personal), Yves Missi: out (knee), Jordan Poole: out (ankle). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
